description: This file defines the AccessSourcer class which generates access modifier strings for Java source code based on access flags and context (class, field, or method). It uses ASM Opcodes for interpretating access flags.

classes.name: AccessSourcer
classes.description: A class responsible for generating access modifier strings for Java source based on given access flags and context.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates a string of access modifiers such as 'public final' based on the provided integer access flags and context filter.
